Oil is approaching $100/bbl on Middle East escalation, capping risk appetite across Asian equities outside of AI-linked names. The yen is surging toward year-highs driven by BOJ hike bets, stop-loss cascades, and yen repatriation speculation — diverging from its typical oil-driven weakness. AI-adjacent plays (SK Hynix, Japanese cable makers) are outperforming on data centre demand. The macro calendar is dense: ECB rate hike expected Thursday, US PPI/CPI due Thursday/Friday, followed by a pivotal Fed decision next week where markets are split on hike vs. hold, and a BoE hold expected.
